title_tag: Family-Owned Land Clearing Company | About 9 Arrow
meta_description: Meet 9 Arrow Land Service, a family-owned land clearing company in Spring Branch, TX, run by John and Camille Wheelock. Our story, our name and our values.
h1: About 9 Arrow, a family-owned land clearing company from Spring Branch
lede: 9 Arrow Land Service is a family-owned land clearing company in Spring Branch, Texas, founded by John and Camille Wheelock. We clear, mulch and prepare land across Central Texas and the Texas Hill Country, and we treat every property as if it were our own.

answer.a: 9 Arrow Land Service is owned by John and Camille Wheelock, a Spring Branch, Texas family with nine children. John brought Texas ranching roots and a construction background, including custom home building, to the company. Forestry mulching became the core of the business after a 2014 project with a land developer and a surveyor.

highlights: Family-owned by John and Camille Wheelock
Driven by precision, rooted in integrity

sections.h2: A family-owned land clearing company built by the Wheelocks
paras: 9 Arrow Land Service belongs to John and Camille Wheelock and their nine children. John comes from Texas ranching roots and a construction background that includes custom home building.

In 2014, a project with a land developer and a surveyor introduced John to forestry mulching. Forestry mulching grinds trees and vegetation where they stand, with no pushing, piling, hauling or burning. [Forestry mulching in Central Texas](forestry-mulching-and-land-clearing) became the core of 9 Arrow and still is today.
The 9 Arrow name comes from Psalm 127:4. "As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth."
John and Camille Wheelock have nine children, and the company name is a nod to that verse and to the family behind the business. Nine children, nine arrows.
9 Arrow runs on nine Biblical core values. Those values guide how we treat clients, crews and the land.
bullets: Honor. We show respect to every client, crew member and neighbor.
Stewardship. We care for the land as something entrusted to us.
Integrity. We do the right thing when nobody is watching.
Honesty. We tell you plainly what your land needs.
Trust. We work to earn it on every job.
Gratitude. We are thankful for the work and the people we serve.
Service. We put your goals for the property first.
Excellence. We do the work well, down to the finish.
Diligence. We stay steady and careful from the first pass to cleanup.

sections.h2: How 9 Arrow looks at Texas land
paras: The Wheelocks are lifelong Texans who appreciate the native landscape. At 9 Arrow, we believe properly cleared and maintained land is healthier, more valuable and more enjoyable to own.

That belief drives responsible land stewardship on every 9 Arrow job. When we work a property, we treat it as if it were our own. We don't consider a job finished unless we're proud of the result, and we design our work to leave a legacy. Our mission line is "Driven by precision, rooted in integrity."

"9 Arrow is an amazing company mostly because they are amazing people! Diligence, honesty, integrity through and through! Talented operators that listen and communicate well. They are a vital part of my land stewardship business!" (Travis Roberson, 5-star Google review)

sections.h2: How 9 Arrow works on your land
paras: Every 9 Arrow job starts with a discovery call, a site visit or both. We price by the day or by the acre once we understand density, tree size and species, topography, access and soil. Our compact track machines handle tight access and slopes, our large articulated wheel machines bring high production, and our equipment includes a CAT 275 compact track loader with a Weiler M860A mulcher.

We serve land developers, commercial real estate, energy and utility providers, solar developers, ranchers and private landowners. We coordinate with licensed surveyors, plumbers, electricians, engineers and general contractors. Start with a [land clearing estimate](get-an-estimate) or browse our [land clearing projects](our-work). It does not get better.

faqs.q: Where is 9 Arrow Land Service based?
faqs.a: 9 Arrow Land Service is based in Spring Branch, Texas. As a service-area business, 9 Arrow comes to your land and works across Central Texas and the Texas Hill Country. Call (210) 247-8410 or email john@9arrow.com to set up a discovery call about your property.

faqs.q: What does the name 9 Arrow mean?
faqs.a: The name 9 Arrow nods to Psalm 127:4, "As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth." Founders John and Camille Wheelock have nine children, and the name connects the family-owned company to that verse and to the family behind it.

faqs.q: How did 9 Arrow get into forestry mulching?
faqs.a: 9 Arrow got into forestry mulching through a 2014 project with a land developer and a surveyor. John Wheelock, who comes from Texas ranching roots and a construction background, was introduced to the method on that project. Forestry mulching then became the core service of 9 Arrow Land Service.

9 Arrow's nine Biblical core values are Honor, Stewardship, Integrity, Honesty, Trust, Gratitude, Service, Excellence and Diligence. The Wheelock family built the company around those values, and they shape how the 9 Arrow crew treats clients, crews and the land on every job.
